args.request: I'd like you to make a city-at-night montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. I've had this nighttime city feeling stuck in my head and would love to see it brought to life. Please show neon signs and a passing train, and somewhere in all of that, this should be 10 seconds long and widescreen, with wet street reflections as well. Cut between those city shots on the beat of the music. I'm excited to see how these pieces come together. There shouldn't be any talking, singing or added text.

story.title: City at Night
story.setting: A big modern city at night after rain, glowing neon light in pink, blue and purple, cinematic and moody.

beats.text: Close shot of glowing neon signs buzzing and flickering on a building facade, slow camera drift.
Wide shot of an elevated train passing quickly across the frame, its lit windows streaking by.
Low shot of a wet street with neon colours reflecting in puddles, a car tire splashes through.

story.music: upbeat electronic, driving synth bass, crisp drums, instrumental, no vocals

1. 0–3 s: close-up of neon signs flickering on a building

3. 7–10 s: neon reflections in puddles on a wet street, with a car tire splashing through

The music is instrumental, made with driving synth bass and crisp drums. There's no talking, singing or text on screen.
